title: Quality Studio rule pool audit entry
description: One line of the append-only rule audit trail (JSON Lines). Project-scope changes are recorded in <project data root>/rules/audit.jsonl, global-scope changes in <data root>/rules/audit.jsonl. Only changes made through the API are recorded; a hand edit of a rule file is visible in the file's own version history instead.

target.description: The rule id, pack id, 'applicability', or the imported rule set's name.

before.description: The previous state of the target, or null. Custom rules and packs are summarised with a content digest.

after.description: The new state of the target, or null when it was removed.
